> Generated by stewards from `.stewards/units/setup.toml`; change prose through the documenter.

# setup: Onboarding and generated files\: init proposes units and writes .stewards, the guide and AGENTS.md block, the per-harness facts table, and docs rendering from unit cards.

## Overview

The setup unit is how a repository gets onto stewards and how the generated files stay true. It proposes units for a repo and writes .stewards, writes the stewards block into AGENTS.md, tells every agent harness the same way to delegate, writes the CI template for the origin's forge, and renders human documentation pages from the unit cards. A reader meets it as init, guide and docs, plus the harness table that guide and init draw on.

## How it works

Plain init (src/init.rs, propose) refuses with already_initialized if units.toml or repo.toml exists. Otherwise it proposes units from manifest roots, source directories and co-change history, naming the repo after its origin URL's last segment, else its directory. Test commands come from what each directory directly holds (dir_tests): repo-wide only from the root, a unit's own (unit_test) from its dir/** paths, skipped when the root covers its toolchain or its directories disagree. It writes both files and the test cards, appends missing .gitignore lines, upserts the AGENTS.md block, and reports, ending with the AGENTS.md-only note. init --draft (draft_jobs) runs only step 1 on an uninitialized repo, briefs an architect job plus a first review per never-reviewed unit, and says to run review --roles until it exits 0; --direct checks every model guard first. init --ci (write_ci) needs an initialized repo with an origin: it picks the forge from the origin host, writes .github/workflows/stewards.yml or .gitlab/stewards.yml pinned to this version (a file with other content is refused, a rerun is a no-op), and adds the path to unowned_ok in repo.toml through toml_edit unless a unit, a tool or unowned_ok covers it. --hooks and render are cut from 0.1.0. src/guide.rs: upsert_block writes the block at the top of AGENTS.md or between its markers; guide prints its paragraphs and one delegation text for every harness. src/harness.rs: detect and by_name. src/docs.rs (pages) renders docs_path pages from cards.

## How to change it

Start from the file for the command: src/init.rs for proposing units, test commands, draft jobs and the CI templates, src/guide.rs for the AGENTS.md block and guide text, src/harness.rs for per-harness facts, src/docs.rs for rendered pages. Each has a test file in tests/ (init.rs, init_draft.rs, guide.rs, docs.rs); change the test with the behavior. Keep true what the contracts promise: plain init never overwrites an initialized repo; the repo-wide test command comes only from the root and a unit's from its own directories; init --draft only runs on an uninitialized repo and checks every model guard before any --direct call; init --ci never overwrites a CI file with other content and keeps repo.toml's comments; the .gitignore step only appends and never duplicates a line in another spelling; upsert_block stays idempotent; stewards writes only AGENTS.md and gives every harness the same delegation text; a harness is only detected when its env rule is verified; docs refuses an empty or escaping docs_path and rewrites only changed files. Keep the card's interface table in step when a contract changes.

## Interface

| id | contract | anchor |
|---|---|---|
| init | Plain \`init\` refuses (already\_initialized) if units.toml or repo.toml exists; else proposes units, writes both files (root-only repo test commands), a test card per unit whose own dirs give one command (else says why), appends missing .gitignore lines, upserts the AGENTS.md block, reports. | [src/init.rs\:\:propose](../../src/init.rs#L733) |
| init-draft | \`init --draft\` runs step 1 only on an uninitialized repo, briefs the architect and a first review per never-reviewed unit (problems recorded as gaps, existing code unchanged), each with a handoff, then says to run \`review --roles\`; with --direct it checks model guards, then submits each job. | [src/init.rs\:\:draft\_jobs](../../src/init.rs#L962) |
| agents-block | Writes the stewards block at the top of AGENTS.md (creating the file), or replaces the text between existing start/end markers; returns whether the file changed, so a rerun is a no-op. | [src/guide.rs\:\:upsert\_block](../../src/guide.rs#L50) |
| guide | \`guide\` prints the block's ritual, handoff, editing and hygiene paragraphs, roles (saying a stamp is one reviewer's no-finding report), adoption, the AGENTS.md-only note, one delegation text for every harness; --all, --errors, --glossary add every harness, the error table, the glossary. | [src/guide.rs\:\:run](../../src/guide.rs#L145) |
| harness-detect | Returns the first harness whose env var prefix matches the current environment; harnesses with an unverified env rule are never detected. | [src/harness.rs\:\:detect](../../src/harness.rs#L145) |
| harness-by-name | Looks up a harness case-insensitively; an unknown name is harness\_unknown listing the valid names. | [src/harness.rs\:\:by\_name](../../src/harness.rs#L155) |
| docs | \`docs \[unit\]\` renders docs\_path/\<unit\>.md for one or every unit plus README.md from cards, tests and repo.toml, escaping card text and linking live anchors; rejects a docs\_path that is empty or escapes the repo and an unknown unit; writes only changed files. | [src/docs.rs\:\:pages](../../src/docs.rs#L53) |
| init-ci | \`init --ci\` on an initialized repo with an origin writes the forge's CI template (.github/workflows/stewards.yml or .gitlab/stewards.yml) once, refuses a file with other content, and adds the path to unowned\_ok unless owned; \`init --hooks\` and \`render\` are cut from 0.1.0. | [src/init.rs\:\:write\_ci](../../src/init.rs#L650) |

## Flows

- documenter-card-to-docs-page: jobs → setup

## Gaps

| kind | title | note |
|---|---|---|
| gap | guide paragraphs are picked by index from BLOCK | guide run splits BLOCK on blank lines and takes parts\[2..=5\]; adding or removing a paragraph in the block silently shifts which text each guide field shows. |
| gap | six harnesses are never detected from env | Harnesses with an unverified env rule are only reachable through guide --harness; detect and telemetry fall back to generic for them. |
| gap | Last reviewed commit is written at line start | esc assumes a tool-written prefix, but unit\_page writes reviewed.commit alone on its line and the commit is not validated; a hand-edited commit like \`1. x\` or \`---\` renders as a list or rule. Cosmetic only\: no HTML or link can form. |
